preconditions.description: The number of BubbleCores N is between 3 and 15,000 inclusive.
There are exactly N lines of electrical wiring provided in the input.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < N and 0 <= v < N and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each wiring connects two distinct BubbleCores with valid indices between 0 and N-1.

preconditions.expression: all(edges.count((u, v)) + edges.count((v, u)) <= 1 for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: No two BubbleCores are connected by more than one line of wiring (no duplicate edges).

preconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for u, v in edges if u == node or v == node) <= 1 for node in range(N))
preconditions.description: No BubbleCore is connected to more than one other BubbleCore (the graph is a collection of disjoint edges and isolated vertices).
It is guaranteed that all BubbleCores can be started (the graph structure allows a valid starting sequence).

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.

postconditions.expression: max_potential_sum == max(sum(potential(node, order) for node in range(N)) for order in valid_starting_orders(N, edges))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible sum of potentials over all valid starting sequences, where potential(node, order) is the number of inactive nodes reachable from node (including itself) at the moment node is started, and valid_starting_orders are sequences where each node (except the first) is connected to an already started node.
